note: Names Seychelles only in a list of countries revising data protection laws to address AI-driven decision-making; that is a data protection law (class other), no AI law or draft is described, and no statement that Seychelles has none.
The passages file holds only the Act's table of contents and short title; no passage names AI or sets a binding rule for it.

facts.fact: A private member's draft Pro-Human Technology Bill, covering AI in employment and education among other technologies, was presented to National Assembly members at a seminar on 6 March 2024; the Speaker said it was still far from reaching the Assembly, and it is expected to go to an Assembly working group.
